brand.name: TERRYTORY Tech
brand.hero_subtitle: Gadgets, software, hardware, science, and the companies shaping what comes next — explained with clarity, not hype.

editorial.publication_description: a smart, accessible technology publication covering consumer gadgets, software, hardware, startups, and science — explaining what's new and why it matters
rating_criteria: Tech Relevance (1-10): Is this genuinely about technology — devices, software, hardware, platforms, startups, or applied science? (Not pure AI research, which has its own niche.)
Novelty & Newsworthiness (1-10): Is this a launch, breakthrough, major update, or meaningful shift? (Or is it a rehash or thin press release?)
Reader Value (1-10): Would a curious, tech-literate reader find this genuinely useful, interesting, or important?
editorial.research_focus: breaking technology development — product launches, hardware and software releases, platform changes, startup and industry moves, and the science behind them
editorial.image_style: Prefer: sleek product photography, gadgets and devices on clean backdrops, circuit boards and hardware close-ups, modern workspaces, futuristic concept imagery. Avoid literal text, logos, or watermarks.
